cache_manifest.generator_model: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; teacher-forced gold/shifted-distractor candidates; no free generation
cache_manifest.representation: Mean over answer tokens, then mean of final 8 transformer layers; selected h_pos/h_neg; pointwise L2 normalization before predictor and geometry
cache_manifest.predictor: Frozen StandardScaler + L2 LogisticRegression(C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=3000); scaler and head fitted on fit rows only; no tuning or held-out selection
cache_manifest.provenance: Offline import of local OVA_ARR token_mode_mean PopQA states; raw TSV candidate reconstruction uses first-N unique questions and cyclic shift-by-one distractors; source SHA-256 recorded. Existing seed-specific test identities preserved from popqa_folds.json.

candidate_policy.rule: SHA256(mondrian-popqa-v1|candidate|seed|question_id), first-byte low bit: 0=pos, 1=neg; independent of labels, probabilities and role

cache_manifest.label_policy: Exact accepted-alias matching after NFKC, casefold and whitespace normalization. Alias collisions are labelled correct without changing candidate or test membership.

split_policy.rule: Preserve saved test IDs. Sort remaining IDs by SHA256(mondrian-popqa-v1|role|seed|question_id); first floor(N/5) update, next floor(N/5) cal, remainder fit.

limitations: Alias nonmatches are dataset-operational negatives; factual invalidity is not independently adjudicated.
Preserves the requested seed-specific historical test set; other historical seeds overlap.
These question states were used in earlier exploratory analyses; this is not a pristine unseen benchmark.

interpretation: Prespecified snapshots; no test-based or calibration-based selection. Prototype kernel memory, not native SDM. All methods share one graph-local scorer.
